name: DarkLight
summary: DarkLight is deployed at the TRIUMF ARIEL electron linac, Vancouver. It is a dedicated low-energy electron-beam dark-sector search, currently located in Canada.
detection_principle: A low-energy electron beam strikes a thin metal target. Two magnetic spectrometers measure coincident e⁺e⁻ pairs for a narrow invariant-mass peak; the X17 motivation is an anomaly interpretation to be tested.

status.label: The current TRIUMF apparatus is in installation / commissioning-related phases; a dated latest confirmation of physics data-taking is lacking

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
